title: Datadog US1 - June Scheduled Maintenance Window
text:
Service: Datadog US1
Maintenance: June Scheduled Maintenance Window
Status: completed
Impact: maintenance
Scheduled for: 2017-06-02T21:00:00.000-04:00
Scheduled until: 2017-06-03T01:00:00.000-04:00
Updates:
- 2017-06-02T22:38:58.446-04:00: completed - Maintenance is complete.
- 2017-06-02T21:23:04.017-04:00: in_progress - Alert notifications have been enabled again. The maintenance is still in progress however the need to disable notifications has passed.
- 2017-06-02T21:13:49.951-04:00: in_progress - We will be disabling alert notifications for a period of 10 minutes.
- 2017-06-02T21:00:56.713-04:00: in_progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
- 2017-05-30T14:16:01.943-04:00: scheduled - We will be performing proactive maintenance for a window of no longer than 4 hours this Friday. 
The window will start at 2017-06-02 21:00 ET (2017-06-03 01:00 UTC). 
During this period, you may come across our 'down' page, but that is to be expected. There may be a brief period during this maintenance window when alerts may not be sent. In this event, we will keep our Status Page updated here. 
*Most importantly*, all of your data will be processed. 
If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us at support@datadoghq.com
